messages.subject: For Keith Neumeyer | Government relations, ESG and Mexico mining execution
messages.body:
Dear First Majestic Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Keith Neumeyer, Chief Executive Officer.

First Majestic's precious-metals operations in Mexico require disciplined coordination across government, regulators, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG, social performance and responsible-mining execution might support First Majestic's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to First Majestic Silver.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
